subject: Phased remit structure, conditional credit corridor, and VAT due diligence — OrthoMed
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@orthomed.com>, OrthoMed Finance <finance@orthomed.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward with a 6-month pilot but we need to align on commercial terms before procurement can issue a PO. Our standard is Net60 for pilot vendors, and given the EU entity setup we'll also need a VAT certificate or guidance on reverse-charge handling so our tax team can approve.

Can you confirm Redwood's ability to accept Net60, and whether you can provide a VAT registration certificate for the EU entity (or confirm reverse charge applies)? Also any standard wording for a credit cap or early-pay discount would be helpful.

Best,
Lina
Lina Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager, OrthoMed
[attachment: orthomed_vat_certificate.pdf (placeholder - customer sent)]
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Hi Lina — super excited to hear the pilot is greenlit. Quick answers and proposal below:

1) Net terms: We typically operate Net45 on hosted accounts but can be flexible for pilots. To balance credit risk and cashflow, we propose a conditional Net60 for the first 90 days with a credit corridor (cap) tied to monthly consumption. If monthly usage exceeds the agreed baseline by >25%, late-payment protection kicks in and we revert to Net30 until the next billing cycle.

2) VAT: thanks for the certificate — our EU legal/finance team needs to validate that the document covers reverse-charge applicability. If reverse charge applies, you will not be billed VAT; otherwise we will invoice VAT and it will be recoverable per local law.

3) Early-pay discount: 1.0% if invoice is paid within 15 days (applies only when Net45/Net60 is accepted).

I'm attaching a proposed invoice timing spreadsheet and a short draft conditional credit agreement for your procurement. Ben and Karthik are looped for the credit cap sizing and tax confirmation.

Next step: Can your team confirm expected monthly consumption (tokens) for the pilot so we can set the baseline? If you prefer, we can put the Net60 as a temporary clause tied to a refundable stability deposit.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
[attachments: redwood_proposed_invoice_schedule_v1.xlsx, conditional_credit_agreement_draft.docx]
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Thanks Marissa — note from finance: we can accept a temporary Net60 for the pilot under one of two operational guards:

- Option A (preferred): Net60 with a credit corridor = 1.5x forecasted monthly spend as an open cap. We perform a mid-pilot usage review at 45 days; if usage exceeds forecast by >30% we request a top-up or switch to Net30.

- Option B: Net60 + refundable stability deposit equal to 0.5x forecasted monthly spend; deposit refunded at end of pilot minus any unpaid invoices.

We will need a short SOW line item to lock the forecasted monthly spend (can be a simple line in the MPA). Also we need a signed VAT attestation from OrthoMed confirming tax residency and whether reverse-charge will be applied.

Happy to take whichever approach reduces friction for procurement. Karthik, please confirm that A/B language is okay from a tax/treasury perspective.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[attachment: finance_note_credit_checks.txt]
From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@orthomed.com>, OrthoMed Finance <finance@orthomed.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Thanks Ben and Marissa — procurement preference is Option A (credit corridor) because a deposit adds procurement overhead. We can provide a firm monthly consumption forecast for the pilot (see below).

Forecast (pilot months 1–6): 800k tokens / month (averaged). We can tolerate a 20% overrun before requiring interim settlement.

On VAT: attached is our VAT registration extract and a short tax note. We believe reverse-charge applies for entitles in the EU but our tax team wants Redwood to confirm.

Can we get a redline of the conditional credit agreement with Option A parameters and the credit corridor set to 1.5x the 800k-token baseline (please convert into an estimated USD cap)? Also please confirm the early-pay discount mechanics.

Best,
Lina
[attachment: orthomed_vat_registration_extract.pdf]
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Lina / team — tax check from our side: based on the VAT extract you provided, reverse-charge should apply for software services delivered from Redwood's non-EU entity to an EU-registered business provided the EU VAT number is valid and listed. To finalize we need the VAT number copied into the invoicing contact and a signed attestation line in the MPA. Otherwise we default to charging UK/EU VAT.

Currency/credit cap conversion: using current list prices and the pilot profile, 800k tokens/month maps roughly to USD 24,000/month. A 1.5x credit corridor equates to USD 36,000 open cap. We recommend the corridor be stated as a dollar cap in the agreement to avoid FX volatility.

Early-pay discount mechanics: 1.0% off net invoice if cleared within 15 days; discount applies to invoice principal only and cannot reduce below zero (standard clause).

I'll prepare a redline of the conditional credit doc with Option A and the USD cap and circulate tomorrow.

Karthik Iyer
Finance Lead, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orthomed.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: payment terms and VAT evidence for pilot contract

Lina — thanks for the quick turnaround and the forecast. Attached is a redlined conditional credit agreement (Option A) and an updated invoice timing sheet that converts token usage to estimated USD and shows the 1.5x corridor. Key points in the redline:

- Credit corridor = USD 36,000 (1.5x baseline)
- Temporary Net60 for pilot months 1–3; if cumulative usage > 1.3x baseline we move to Net30 for remainder of pilot unless a top-up is arranged.
- Early-pay discount 1.0% within 15 days (applies to Net45/Net60 invoices).
- VAT: invoice will omit VAT when OrthoMed provides valid VAT number and signed attestation; otherwise VAT will be applied.

If this looks good procurement can sign, then our legal ops will generate a short SOW line for the forecast and we'll be ready to issue the PO.

Would you like the redline as a tracked-change Word doc or as clean copy ready for signature?

Thanks — I can jump on a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to finalize.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0134
[attachments: conditional_credit_agreement_draft_redline.docx, redwood_proposed_invoice_schedule_v2.xlsx]
